map.根据拖车总质量和建议的球头载荷比例，估算拖车球头（Tongue Load）垂直载: Estimates the vertical load on the trailer hitch ball (tongue load) from gross trailer mass and the recommended tongue-load ratio.
map.集中在轴组前方（增载荷）: Concentrated ahead of axle group (increases load)
map.⚖️ 过低与过高的后果: ⚖️ Consequences of Too Low or Too High
map.球头载荷低于总重 10% 时拖车易出现蛇形摇摆（尤其下坡与侧风），高于 15%: With tongue load below 10% of gross weight the trailer easily sways (especially downhill or in crosswinds); above 15% it unloads the tow vehicle's front axle, weakening steering and braking. Both are dangerous.
map.重物应集中在拖车轴组上方，避免堆在尾端（杠杆效应会放大摇摆）。调载后用球头秤实测: Keep heavy items over the trailer axle group, never stacked at the tail (leverage amplifies sway). After reloading, measure with a tongue scale and check both the tow vehicle's hitch ball rating and the GCWR.
map.💡 务必以牵引车说明书标注的 Tongue Load 上限为准，不同车型差异较大: 💡 Always follow the Tongue Load limit given in the tow vehicle manual; ratings vary widely between models (commonly 200~350 kg).
map.📚 深度解析：拖车球头载荷计算: 📚 In-depth: Trailer Hitch Ball Load Calculator
map.自驾拖挂房车或拖斗前，校核球头垂直载荷是否在车辆与拖车额定范围内，避免前轴减负甩: Before towing a camper or utility trailer, verify that vertical hitch load stays within vehicle and trailer ratings to avoid unloading the front axle and fishtailing.
map.装载时调整货物前后位置，使球头载荷落在总重 10%–15% 的建议区间。: While loading, shift cargo fore/aft so tongue load lands within the recommended 10%–15% of gross weight.
map.对比不同拖车总重时，确认球头载荷不超过 SUV/皮卡说明书的 Tongue Lo: When comparing trailer weights, confirm the tongue load does not exceed the Tongue Load limit in the SUV/pickup manual.
map.拖车总重 1500kg，建议球头载荷为总重 10%–15% 即 150–225k: Trailer gross weight 1500kg; recommended tongue load is 10%–15% of gross, i.e. 150–225kg. If the measured ball load is 260kg and thus over the limit, move cargo rearward or reduce load; also confirm the tow vehicle's hitch ball rating (commonly 200–350kg) is adequate.
map.球头载荷和总重什么关系？: How does tongue load relate to gross weight?
map.球头载荷是拖车作用在牵引车挂钩上的垂直向下力，通常应占拖车总重的 10%–15%: Tongue load is the downward vertical force the trailer applies to the tow vehicle's hitch, normally 10%–15% of gross trailer weight. Too low (<10%) makes the trailer sway; too high (>15%) unloads the front axle and weakens steering and braking. Both are dangerous.
map.怎么调球头载荷？: How do I adjust tongue load?
map.在拖车内向前移重物降低球头载荷、向后移提高球头载荷；配重应集中在轴组上方而非拖车: Move cargo forward inside the trailer to reduce tongue load, rearward to increase it; keep the load over the axle group rather than at the tail. Once adjusted, measure with a tongue scale and stay within the tow vehicle's rating before driving off.
map.球头载荷须用球头秤实测，并同时核对牵引车说明书标注的额定上限: Tongue load must be measured with a tongue scale and checked against the tow vehicle manual rating
